title: Shariah Equity Purification
description: Screens one company's caller-supplied financial values under four pinned Shariah screening methodologies (MSCI long-form and average-cap, FTSE daily-average, NIFTY TASIS conservative), each verdict reported separately, never merged. Threshold comparisons are exact integer cross-multiplication on minor units; the compliant-debt carve-out covers eleven pinned country codes; purification runs per profile; unlisted methodologies refuse by name. Outputs verdict rows and purification arithmetic only.

methodologies.description: Authority profiles to screen under, each verdict reported separately and never merged. An entry outside the pinned set refuses by name and never approximates.

is_current_constituent.description: Required when either MSCI profile is requested: true applies the retention threshold set, false applies the lower new-inclusion set and raises a flag saying so.

country_code.description: Required when either MSCI profile is requested: two-letter uppercase ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code. One of eleven pinned codes activates the compliant-debt carve-out.

shariah_compliant_debt_minor.description: Required when the carve-out country set applies: the portion of total debt a cited supervisory list treats as Shariah-compliant and excludes from the total-debt numerator. Must not exceed total_debt_minor.

total_assets_minor.description: Total assets in integer minor units; the long-form, daily-average-fallback and conservative denominators. Must be positive.

total_debt_minor.description: Total (conventional or interest-bearing) debt in integer minor units.

cash_and_interest_bearing_securities_min.description: Cash plus interest-bearing securities in integer minor units; its own ratio row on every profile.

receivables_minor.description: Trade and other receivables in integer minor units; combined with cash on the long-form, average-cap and conservative rows.

total_revenue_minor.description: Required for the daily-average profile: total revenue in integer minor units, the denominator of the business-activity row.

non_permissible_revenue_minor.description: Revenue from non-permissible business activities in integer minor units; numerator of the business-activity row and a purification input.

interest_income_minor.description: Interest income in integer minor units; a non-permissible-income numerator member and the conservative purification numerator.

total_income_minor.description: Total income in integer minor units; the non-permissible-income and purification denominators. Must be positive.

interest_based_investments_minor.description: Required for the conservative profile: interest-bearing investments in integer minor units, imputed at 7.5 percent in the income row.

market_cap_series_minor.description: Required for the average-cap and daily-average profiles: period market capitalizations in integer minor units, 1 to 600 elements, each at most 1e13. Averages are reported floored with named rounding while verdicts use the exact mean.

market_cap_series_period.description: Required alongside the series: exactly month_end or day. The average-cap profile is defined on month-end observations and refuses a daily series rather than mis-averaging.

dividend_minor.description: Optional dividend in integer minor units. When present, purification runs per profile: the long-form adjustment factor, the conservative pro-rata income ratio; the daily-average profile pins no rule and says so.

The compliant-debt carve-out covers eleven pinned country codes; purification runs per profile; unlisted methodologies refuse by name. Outputs verdict rows and purification arithmetic only.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads, with the declared bounds mirrored from the kernel constants. No required array at the schema layer: which fields are mandatory depends on the requested authority profiles, and the kernel refuses each absent required field by name as a structured refusal payload, so every refusal branch stays reachable through every call path.
author: PostOakLabs

verdicts.description: One verdict group per requested authority profile, keyed by profile name; null on refusal. Groups are never merged.
